articles.title: 1 person injured after overnight rollover crash near Etobicoke’s Humber Bay Park
articles.summary: A driver was taken to the hospital early Tuesday after a single‑vehicle rollover near Humber Bay Park, Toronto police say. The collision happened around 2:53 a.m., when Toronto Paramedic Services received reports of a vehicle that had flipped in the Lake Shore Boulevard West and Park Lawn Road area. articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating after officers heard gunfire early Tuesday morning near a commercial plaza in Rexdale. articles.title: Fog advisory and rising humidex of near 40 mark muggy start to September in Toronto
articles.summary: Toronto is stepping into September under thick fog, rising humidity and the risk of scattered showers and thunderstorms, as Environment Canada issues a fog advisory for the city and parts of the eastern GTA. articles.title: Liberals win byelection in Beaches-East York, keeping seat vacated by Erskine-Smith
articles.summary: Liberal Tanveer Shahnawaz won Monday’s byelection in the federal riding of Beaches-East York, maintaining the party’s hold on the Toronto-area seat. articles.summary: A man has been arrested for allegedly taking photos of an 11-year-old girl in the washroom at Kew Gardens. articles.title: Inquest set for 88-year-old who died after well-being check by Peel police in 2023
articles.summary: An inquest will be held next week into the death of an 88-year-old man who died after he fell down a flight of stairs during a well-being check by Peel police in Mississauga nearly three years ago.

articles.title: Ontario's new cash bail system on hold after judge grants injunction
articles.summary: Ontario's new cash bail system has been put on hold while a judge weighs a challenge to its constitutionality.

articles.title: Disbarred Brampton lawyer charged in alleged $4.3M fraud scheme: Peel police
articles.summary: A disbarred Brampton lawyer has been arrested and charged with allegedly orchestrating four mortgage and cheque fraud schemes totaling around $4.3-million, Peel police say.

articles.summary: The CBC News decision desk is projecting Liberal Tanveer Shahnawaz will win the federal byelection in the Toronto riding of Beaches-East York.

articles.title: Oshawa plant adds truck as unionized Canadian GM members ratify new deals
articles.summary: The union said the three-year collective agreements increase wages for full-rate production members to $50.20 an hour and skilled trades workers to $62.71 an hour.

articles.title: Voters head to the polls for 3 federal byelections in Ontario, Quebec and B.C.
articles.summary: Voters are heading to the polls on Monday to decide three federal byelections in the B.C. riding of North Vancouver-Capilano, the Ontario riding of Beaches-East York and the Quebec riding of Chicoutimi-Le Fjord.

articles.title: Toronto cinema says it was forced to cancel screenings over decades-old, unofficial 'zone' system
articles.summary: A downtown Toronto cinema says it was forced to cancel screenings of a new movie after the film’s distributor unexpectedly withdrew access — citing a decades-old practice in Canada that limits which theatres can show movies first.
